name: Standard
artBrief: Factory-issue graphite gunmetal; a practical satin receiver with dark grips and exposed mechanical details.

name: Arctic
artBrief: Pale glacier-white ceramic plating over graphite grips, rails and mechanisms; clean cold-weather precision.

name: Crimson Edge
artBrief: Deep oxblood-red coated receiver with subdued steel accents; aggressive and military rather than candy red.

name: Emerald
artBrief: Dark emerald anodized metal over charcoal furniture; jewel-toned but grounded tactical finishing.

name: Carbon Fiber
artBrief: Visible graphite-and-slate woven carbon-fiber across the complete receiver, stock and magazine, with dark hardware. The pattern reads at gameplay distance.

name: Neon Pulse
artBrief: Almost-black high-tech casing with cyan illuminated highlights; a futuristic pulse against the dark chassis.

name: Inferno
artBrief: Smoked dark metal with hot ember-orange illumination; the impression of a weapon forged in a furnace.

name: Gold Standard
artBrief: Warm satin gold-plated receiver with shadowed bronze and black rails, controls and grips; premium but mechanically legible.

name: Eventide
artBrief: Animated midnight-indigo and violet starfield with drifting points of light and cool spectral glow.

name: Viridian Blight
artBrief: Dark oxidized green with slowly moving acid-green mottling and subdued mint luminescence.

name: Cobalt Alloy
artBrief: Exclusive deep-blue alloy with bright steel and midnight-blue furniture; available from the Credit Shop.

name: Void Circuit
artBrief: Career-exclusive rich violet plating with glowing lavender circuitry, black mechanical inserts and subdued futuristic luminescence.
